description: Read the text of one file in a bucket (notes, CSV, JSON, logs, code, HTML, SQL). Returns up to max_bytes (default 64 KB, at most 256 KB) starting at offset; for a bigger file call again with the returned next_offset. Binary files (images, PDFs, archives) are not read; use storage_file_link for those. To find the right file first, use search_storage_files.

bucket.description: Bucket name (3-63 lowercase letters, digits, dots, hyphens).

region.description: Region code from storage_plans or storage_overview, e.g. fra (Frankfurt), usa (Virginia), sgp (Singapore).

service_id.description: Object Storage service id, as returned by the matching list tool.

name: read_storage_file
title: Read a file from storage
